name: MonarchAssigneePicker
title: AssigneePicker
wrapsNative: MonarchEntityPicker (androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and a LazyColumn of MonarchAvatar rows) and a MonarchButton for Assign to me
summary: A people picker for assigning work: the current user first as "Name (you)", an "Unassigned" row, an "Assign to me" shortcut, and one or several assignees.
whenToUse: To set who owns a task, ticket, deal or record, from the workspace's members.
whenNotToUse: For records that are not people use MonarchEntityPicker; for a plain list of options use MonarchCombobox.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAssigneePicker(people: List<MonarchAssigneePerson>, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, selectedPeople: List<MonarchAssigneePerson> = emptyList(), currentUserId: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, allowUnassigned: Boolean = true, showAssignToMe: Boolean = true, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, search: (suspend (String) -> List<MonarchAssigneePerson>)? = null, labels: MonarchAssigneePickerLabels = MonarchAssigneePickerLabels())

@Composable fun MonarchAssigneePicker(people: List<MonarchAssigneePerson>, selected: List<String>, onSelectedChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, selectedPeople: List<MonarchAssigneePerson> = emptyList(), currentUserId: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, showAssignToMe: Boolean = true, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, search: (suspend (String) -> List<MonarchAssigneePerson>)? = null, labels: MonarchAssigneePickerLabels = MonarchAssigneePickerLabels())
class MonarchAssigneePerson(val id: String, val name: String, val email: String? = null, val image: Painter? = null, val hint: String? = null, val enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchAssigneePickerLabels(label: String? = null, unassigned: String? = null, you: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, assignToMe: String? = null, count: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, search: String? = null, picker: MonarchEntityPickerLabels = MonarchEntityPickerLabels())

options.name: people
options.description: The people to choose from, in the app's order; the current user is moved first.

options.name: selected
options.description: The assigned id (null for unassigned), or the assigned ids in the multiple-choice overload.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the new assignee or assignees.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the column holding the field and the shortcut.

options.name: selectedPeople
options.description: People for the selection who may not be in people, for their names and avatars.

options.name: currentUserId
options.description: The signed-in user: listed first as "Name (you)" and the target of Assign to me.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field and the shortcut can be used.

options.name: required
options.description: Shows the required mark after the label.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows Loading… in the list while people is empty.

options.name: allowUnassigned
options.description: Single choice only: offers the Unassigned row and shows Unassigned in the empty field.

options.name: showAssignToMe
options.description: Shows Assign to me under the field when currentUserId is set and not yet assigned.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error message, read with the field.

options.name: search
options.description: Searches people on the app's server, debounced by MonarchEntityPicker; the current user stays first in the results.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Assignee, Unassigned, (you), Assign to me, the count, the search placeholder and the entity picker's strings.

states.name: unassigned
states.description: The field reads "Unassigned"; Assign to me is shown when a current user is known.

states.name: assigned
states.description: The field shows the person's avatar and name; Assign to me is hidden once the current user is assigned.

states.name: several
states.description: The multiple-choice field reads "2 people"; the sheet stays open until Done.

states.name: loading
states.description: The list shows Loading… while people is empty or a search runs.

states.name: error
states.description: The error message is shown under the field and read with it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field cannot be opened and the shortcut is hidden.

appearance: MonarchEntityPicker's field and sheet: the surface fill with the input border, avatars with initials when there is no picture, muted emails and hints, the accent strong selection mark; Assign to me is a ghost MonarchButton in the accent text color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web AssigneePicker is a popover listbox with a footer button and an avatar stack in the trigger. On Android it is MonarchEntityPicker's field and bottom sheet, the pattern of the system contact pickers, and Assign to me is a button under the field, so it works without opening the sheet. The trigger shows the first avatar and "N people" instead of an avatar stack. MonarchEntityPicker rows have no group headings and no presence dot, so the web's group and status fields of a person are not offered; the current user is moved to the top of the whole list. The uncontrolled value/defaultValue props are replaced by the hoisted selected value. No iOS entry exists yet.
accessibility: The field is one TalkBack element named by its label ("Assignee") with the assignee, or "Unassigned", as its state.
Rows are selectable with the radio role in single choice and checkboxes in multiple choice; a person who cannot be picked is read as disabled.
The current user's row says "(you)" in words.
Assign to me is a button with a 48dp touch target.
Avatars are decorative; the name is read once.
edgeCases: Assign to me disappears once the current user is assigned, and is never shown while the picker is disabled.
In the multiple-choice picker Assign to me adds the current user to the end of the selection.
A current user who is not in people is not added to the list.
Long names wrap in the rows; the field shows one line.

examples.title: Assignee with you and Unassigned
examples.template:
MonarchAssigneePicker(
    initiallyOpen = true,
    people = members,
    selected = assignee,
    onSelectedChange = { assignee = it },
    currentUserId = {{currentUserId}},
    labels = MonarchAssigneePickerLabels(label = {{label}}),
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var assignee by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>({{value}}) }
val members = listOf(
    MonarchAssigneePerson({{people.0.id}}, {{people.0.name}}, email = {{people.0.email}}, hint = {{people.0.hint}}, group = {{people.0.group}}),
    MonarchAssigneePerson({{people.1.id}}, {{people.1.name}}, email = {{people.1.email}}, group = {{people.1.group}}, status = MonarchPresenceStatus.{{people.1.status|pascal}}),
    MonarchAssigneePerson({{people.2.id}}, {{people.2.name}}, email = {{people.2.email}}, group = {{people.2.group}}),
    MonarchAssigneePerson({{people.3.id}}, {{people.3.name}}, email = {{people.3.email}}, group = {{people.3.group}}, status = MonarchPresenceStatus.{{people.3.status|pascal}}),
    MonarchAssigneePerson({{people.4.id}}, {{people.4.name}}, email = {{people.4.email}}, group = {{people.4.group}}),
)
examples.setup:
var assignee by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>("m2") }
val members = listOf(
    MonarchAssigneePerson("m1", "Priya Raman", email = "priya@example.com", hint = "4 open", group = "In this team"),
    MonarchAssigneePerson("m2", "Jonas Weber", email = "jonas@example.com", group = "In this team", status = MonarchPresenceStatus.Online),
    MonarchAssigneePerson("m3", "Amara Okafor", email = "amara@example.com", group = "Everyone else"),
    MonarchAssigneePerson("m4", "Lucas Martin", email = "lucas@example.com", group = "Everyone else", status = MonarchPresenceStatus.Away),
    MonarchAssigneePerson("m5", "Mei Chen", email = "mei@example.com", group = "Everyone else"),
)

MonarchAssigneePicker(
    initiallyOpen = true,

parityExceptions.reason: The web label of this button joins its visible text and hidden text with no separator; on Android the button is named with a sentence for TalkBack and its visible text is shown as it is.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
